featured_reviews.name: Tejas Padte
featured_reviews.review_text:
Our lab had this tradition that every member goes to printing thesis for their colleagues.  That's our way of extending support. It also helps us understand the exact requirements and process. So by the time it's your turn, you're well versed with every minute details in formatting. Making it a smooth sail for you. So have visited Patel printers for quite a few occasions. He mainly specializes into thesis printing, although other jobs can also be done with equal competency.
Situated just opposite to IIT Market, Patel has established themselves as a brand in thesis printing with throughput of 4-5 thesis per day. You reach there and one of their person will take your data. Go through it and start their magic. It's as if they know the guidelines by heart and within no time they start making amendments in your softcopy. May it be latex, word, or any other format. They would work with it. Similarly in case of images may it be Corel /photoshop, their people can help u edit it.
However it's recommended that one carries their laptop in case of specific softwares.
Once done, a final glance is what they ask you to go through in softcopy and then it's sent for printing.
Their printers are highly efficient ones and give 100 prints per minute. So within no time will you see your first copy printed (not bound) in front of you. They expect you to go through the same page by page and sort out pages you want to be re done. Those changes are then done and new print out is taken, old pages are replaced with these new ones and you're called next day to collect the copies.
Good things don't come cheap, and so is Patel. An average 200-230 pages thesis without any special image paper used will cost around 3000/-  per piece. However for those who want their last minute sail to be smooth where someone can help them solve and technical issues cropping up last moment, Patel is your place.

Please call him a day before you plan to take your thesis to make sure they are not overbooked that day... Good luck!
